_about: Brief for renaming channel 10 after the owner's 17 Nov 2026 decision to redesign it for adults. Read by the naming agent.

network.goal: One brand in a 13-channel faceless YouTube portfolio, built to last for years. Each channel stands on its own.

channels.label: wordless animated Shorts for adults
channels.concept: Wordless 3D-animated Shorts (and later short episodes) in which very small original characters (a snail, a pebble, a raindrop, an ant, a button) face very adult days: the commute, the job interview, rent, insomnia, a wedding alone, being let go, burnout.
channels.angle: Tiny characters, grown-up problems. Dry, deadpan humour with real warmth; cinematic lighting and muted colours; every episode its own situation and ending. No words, so it travels worldwide.
channels.tone: deadpan, wry, warm, cinematic; for adults. Must NOT sound cute, childish, toy-like or like a kids' cartoon: YouTube's made-for-kids rules make a child-appealing brand a legal problem.
channels.boundary_with_existing: The only animated, wordless channel in the portfolio.
channels.previous_candidates: Names judged under the earlier kids' concept, all of which were CLEAR on YouTube: Errandlings, Tall Errands, Thimble Summit, Pluck and Pennant, Doorstep Odyssey, Gumption Lane, Pinch of Pluck. Reuse one only if it truly fits the adult concept; several (for example Pinch of Pluck) skew childish.
